title: The debug-token exchange and JWKS routes, and whether the side serves them at all
oracle: official Local Emulator Suite, pinned in ORACLE.md

steps.reason: The official Local Emulator Suite serves no App Check exchange route at all, so the oracle answers 404. firebase-testd issues a locally signed token for a registered debug secret.
No route on the oracle (404) against the specified 403 PERMISSION_DENIED "App attestation failed." that firebase-testd returns for an unknown project, app, disabled app or secret alike.

error.message: limited-use App Check tokens need replay protection (APPCHECK-REPLAY-1), which this runtime does not implement

steps.documents: capability manifest APPCHECK-REPLAY-1 (crates/firebase-testd/src/control.rs); docs/specifications/firebase-app-check.md sections 17 and 23
steps.reason: No route on the oracle (404). firebase-testd fails closed with 501 UNIMPLEMENTED / APP_CHECK_REPLAY_UNSUPPORTED rather than issuing a reusable token for a limited-use request.
The official suite serves no JWKS route (404). firebase-testd publishes this instance's single public App Check key as an RFC 7517 JWK Set.

steps.production: Section 23 lists the extra claims on a production limited-use token as unresolved debt. The official suite issues no App Check token at all, so nothing local can record them.
